**Internet Blocker** cuts Wi-Fi and mobile data for the Android apps you choose. No root, no ads, no
tracking, and the app has no internet permission of its own, so nothing ever leaves your phone.

### 📲 Install or update

1. Download the `.apk` below and open it on your phone (allow installs from your browser or file manager
   if asked), or run `adb install -r <file>.apk` from a computer.
2. Open **Internet Blocker**, pick the apps to block, turn **Blocking** on, and accept Android's
   *Connection request* dialog.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Builds are debug-signed: if an update refuses to install over an older
version, uninstall the old one first.

### ☕ Support

Internet Blocker is free and open source. If it's useful to you, you can
[buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/casunoxd). Thank you!
